observationTimePrecision: Approximate minute; observations are from the completed initial Chromium and HTTP phases of the first-release verifier run.
source: Actual successful assertion output from output/production/verify-production.mjs in the agent tool transcript. The run was stopped during repeated Firefox Cloudflare-DNS-over-HTTPS transport timeouts; its final full per-observation JSON had not yet been flushed.

initialFindings.name: Contact strict HTML byte comparison differs
initialFindings.cause: Existing Cloudflare zone Email Address Obfuscation rewrites public email text and mailto links and adds its decoder script. Normal JavaScript rendering restores the correct email and mailto values.
initialFindings.rootFollowUp: Root is adding documented email_off markers only around the Contact public email section to retain direct no-JavaScript email behavior. Final release requires focused verification.

initialFindings.name: Default local DNS and Firefox Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS reachability
initialFindings.cause: Default Node/Chromium retained ENOTFOUND. Google public DNS returned 104.21.60.170 and 172.67.198.110; Node and Chromium using the published 104.21.60.170 answer passed normal TLS. Firefox Cloudflare DoH first returned Home 200, then repeated timeouts during the complete run. A separate Firefox Google DoH Home probe returned 200.
initialFindings.action: Stopped repeated Firefox transport timeouts. Final focused Firefox verification will use per-browser Google DoH; no machine DNS settings or TLS verification changed.

limitations: Summarized successful first-run assertions are preserved here; full per-observation in-memory results were not flushed before the Firefox transport phase was stopped.

Automated Node/Chromium used a current public DNS answer in-process while retaining the actual HTTPS hostname, SNI and ordinary certificate validation. Root separately verified normal user Chrome Home and Contact without DNS override.
No physical devices, OS screen readers, worldwide DNS propagation or field Web Vitals are claimed.
